title: Synergistic inhibition of gastric cancer cell proliferation by concanavalin A and silibinin via attenuation of the JAK/STAT3 signaling pathway and molecular docking analysis.
authors: Hua, Gaoyan; Zhao, Lisha; Zeng, Xianjing; Luo, Liang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然药物Con-A与silibinin联合抑制胃癌细胞增殖及JAK/STAT3信号通路，分子对接仅作为辅助手段，核心为细胞实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: In the current period of pharmaceutical discovery, herbal remedies have shown to be an unmatched supply of anticancer medications. Plants and their derivatives, through analogues, play a vital role in cancer treatment. OBJECTIVES: The current investigation assessed the effectiveness of inhibiting the growth of gastric cancer cells in AGS cells by blocking the JAK/ STAT3 signalling pathways using the natural medicines Concanavalin A (Con-A) and silibinin (SB). MATERIALS AND METHODS: After being exposed to various doses of concanavalin A, and silibinin (Con-A + SB) for 24 h (0- 60 microM), the cells were evaluated for multiple studies. The MTT assay was used to examine the combination of Con-A + SB-induced cytotoxicity. To evaluate ROS, DCFH-DA staining was utilized. Dual (AO/EtBr) staining was performed to examine apoptotic modifications, and MMP levels in AGS cells were examined using the appropriate fluorescence staining assays. By using flow cytometry and western blotting, cell cycle, and apoptosis were assessed. RESULTS: The relative cytotoxicity of Con-A and SB was found to be approximately 19.6 muM and 16.78 muM, (p < 0.05) correspondingly, according to the findings. After a 24-h incubation period, the combination of Con-A and SB generates significant cytotoxicity in AGS cells, with an IC(50) of 10.37 muM (p < 0.01). Furthermore, AGS cells treated with Con-A and SB concurrently showed increased apoptotic signals, exhibited by Bax overexpression, Bcl-2 downregulation, and Caspase-3 activation, as well as considerable ROS generation. CONCLUSION: Therefore, the combination usage of Con-A + SB has the potential to serve as a chemotherapeutic agent since it prevents the synthesis of JAK/STAT3 intermediated control of proliferation and cell cycle-regulating proteins.
abstract_zh: 背景：在当前药物发现阶段，草药已被证明是抗癌药物无与伦比的供应来源。植物及其衍生物通过类似物在癌症治疗中发挥重要作用。目的：本研究评估了使用天然药物刀豆球蛋白A（Concanavalin A, Con-A）和水飞蓟宾（silibinin, SB）通过阻断JAK/STAT3信号通路来抑制AGS细胞中胃癌细胞生长的有效性。材料与方法：将细胞暴露于不同剂量的刀豆球蛋白A和水飞蓟宾（Con-A + SB）24小时（0-60微摩尔）后，进行多项研究评估。使用MTT实验检测Con-A + SB联合诱导的细胞毒性。采用DCFH-DA染色评估ROS。进行双重（AO/EtBr）染色以检查凋亡变化，并使用适当的荧光染色实验检测AGS细胞中的MMP水平。通过流式细胞术和蛋白质印迹法评估细胞周期和凋亡。结果：根据结果，Con-A和SB的相对细胞毒性分别约为19.6微摩尔和16.78微摩尔（p < 0.05）。在24小时孵育期后，Con-A和SB联合在AGS细胞中产生显著细胞毒性，IC(50)为10.37微摩尔（p < 0.01）。此外，同时用Con-A和SB处理的AGS细胞显示出增加的凋亡信号，表现为Bax过表达、Bcl-2下调、Caspase-3激活，以及显著的ROS生成。结论：因此，Con-A + SB的联合使用具有作为化疗药物的潜力，因为它阻止了JAK/STAT3介导的增殖和细胞周期调节蛋白合成的控制。
